TRANSPARENCY & DATA PROTECTION

Effective Date: July 26, 2026Last Updated: July 26, 2026

Welcome to Korvion Media. Your privacy is important to us, and we are committed to protecting the personal information you share with us. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, disclose, and safeguard your information.

1. About Korvion Media

Korvion Media is a digital marketing company providing strategic and technology-driven business growth solutions. Our services include:

Search Engine Optimization (SEO)
Performance Marketing
Branding & Creative Services
Website Design & Development
Content Production & Social Media
CRM & Marketing Automation
Mobile & Web App Development
Digital Growth Consulting

As part of delivering these services, we may collect certain personal and technical information that enables us to communicate with you, improve our services, and provide a secure user experience.

2. Information We Collect

Personal Information

You may voluntarily provide personal information when you submit enquiry forms, request quotations, book consultations, subscribe to newsletters, apply for careers, or communicate via email/WhatsApp.

  • Full Name & Company Name
  • Email Address & Phone Number
  • Business Website & Location
  • Job Title & Service Requirements
  • Voluntarily provided context details

Technical Information & Automated Collection

When you browse our website, technical details such as IP address, browser type, device info, operating system, screen resolution, referral source, pages visited, session duration, and click behavior may be collected automatically to maintain website performance and security.

3. Cookies & Analytics Platforms

Our website uses cookies and trusted analytics services to understand visitor behavior and improve user experience.

Google Analytics & Search Console

Meta Pixel & Ads Tracking

Microsoft Clarity & LinkedIn Tag

These platforms collect anonymized usage details to measure site traffic and conversion events. They do not grant us access to passwords, financial details, or sensitive personal files.

4. How We Use Your Information

Information collected is used strictly for legitimate business purposes:

  • Responding to enquiries and scheduling consultations
  • Preparing proposals, quotations, and service agreements
  • Delivering requested digital marketing, web, and technology services
  • Improving website functionality, user experience, and technical security
  • Communicating essential service updates and newsletter insights (with consent)
  • Preventing fraudulent activities and maintaining regulatory compliance

5. Data Sharing & Security Protection

Korvion Media does not sell, rent, or trade your personal information to third parties for independent marketing purposes.

Service Providers: We may share data with trusted cloud infrastructure, hosting providers, CRM platforms, and security tools necessary for business operations.

Security Measures: We employ SSL encryption, secure hosting infrastructure, firewall protections, and strict access controls to safeguard your data.

6. Your Privacy Rights

Depending on your location, you hold rights regarding your personal information, including the right to request access, request correction of inaccurate data, request deletion, withdraw consent, or object to processing.

To exercise any privacy rights, reach out directly to our privacy officer via email at korvionmedia@gmail.com.

Have Questions About Your Privacy?

If you have questions or concerns regarding this Privacy Policy or our data handling practices, our team is here to assist you.
